title: Travel: Paul McCartney – Nice to Monaco | 1970
content:
Paul and Linda McCartney drove from Nice in France to Monaco on 23 September 1970.

They had flown to Nice the previous day from Liverpool.

The McCartneys spent several days exploring the French Riviera before embarking on the SS France to New York, where their album Ram would be recorded.
